prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic photography style. An adult Asian woman sits in front of a bay window in a high-rise building, wearing a very loose white shirt with a relaxed neckline. From a subjective POV, she gently raises her right hand to block the lens with a faint smile and says, "Oh... stop taking pictures of me." The lens keeps the POV perspective as she lowers her hand and leans closer until her face occupies most of the frame. She looks directly at the lens with a deeper friendly smile and says, "Stop taking pictures... let's change the scene." Keep natural window light, delicate realistic detail, film grain, a subtle rustling sound of sleeves, isolated city noise outside, and quiet indoor air. Avoid explicit intimacy or physical contact.
